transcript:
Transcript
M: Welcome to Language Today on KXRP Radio. (71) I’m Ted Costello, and I’ll be your host this hour. For today’s show, I’m thrilled to be interviewing (72) language specialist Dr. Eric Alfson right here in the studio. (72) Dr. Alfson has recently completed groundbreaking research into child language acquisition in bilingual homes. He has agreed to tell us about the surprising results even before (73) his new book hits stores on August 4. Dr. Alfson, it’s a pleasure to welcome you to this program.

questions.text: Who most likely is Ted Costello?
questions.explanation: Người nói tự giới thiệu: 'Welcome to Language Today on KXRP Radio. I'm Ted Costello, and I'll be your host this hour.' => Ted Costello là người dẫn chương trình radio (A radio host). Chọn (C).

questions.text: What does Dr. Alfson specialize in?
questions.explanation: Người dẫn giới thiệu: '...interviewing language specialist Dr. Eric Alfson...' => Tiến sĩ Alfson là chuyên gia chuyên nghiên cứu về ngôn ngữ (The study of language). Chọn (D).

questions.text: What will happen on August 4?

options.A: Dr. Alfson’s new book will be available.
options.B: A new research project will be launched.
options.C: The radio will broadcast an interview.
options.D: The results of a study will be announced.

questions.explanation: Người dẫn nhắc đến mốc thời gian: '...even before his new book hits stores on August 4.' (trước khi cuốn sách mới lên kệ vào ngày 4/8) => Cuốn sách mới của Tiến sĩ Alfson sẽ được phát hành (Dr. Alfson's new book will be available). Chọn (A).

Good evening, and welcome to the Lucero Theater. Transcript
M: I’m glad to see that everyone was able to make it today. Our first order of business, before the presentations, is to offer our sincere appreciation to (77) Dr. Darren Heinz, who was the top donor to the Bright Future Research Foundation. Thanks to his generous contribution, our poverty research team will be able to continue numerous projects. Their work for the past fifteen years has been at the forefront of this field, (78) and this money will allow the development of new initiatives to better assist disadvantaged children and teenagers. We are so pleased that we reached our fundraising goal this year. (79)We hope all of you will be able to attend a celebratory dinner to honor Dr. Heinz and our other supporters at the Eagle Club on November 12.

questions.text: How will the funding be used?

options.A: To give assistance to needy youth

questions.explanation: Người nói giải thích mục đích tiền tài trợ: '...this money will allow the development of new initiatives to better assist disadvantaged children and teenagers.' Cụm từ 'disadvantaged children and teenagers' được diễn đạt lại (paraphrase) thành 'needy youth' (thanh thiếu niên có hoàn cảnh khó khăn). Chọn (A) To give assistance to needy youth.

questions.text: What will occur on November 12?

options.B: A special dinner will be held.
options.C: An achievement test will be taken.
options.D: A grand opening will be organized.

questions.explanation: Người nói thông báo: 'We hope all of you will be able to attend a celebratory dinner to honor Dr. Heinz and our other supporters at the Eagle Club on November 12.' => Một bữa tiệc tối đặc biệt sẽ được tổ chức vào ngày 12/11 (A special dinner will be held). Chọn (B).

Transcript
M: Researchers at the Minnesota Sleep Clinic are recruiting volunteers to participate in (83) the largest-ever study about the effects of caffeine on sleep. Dr. Wendy Senequa, lead researcher for the project, said that (84) participants will spend seven days at the clinic having their sleep patterns monitored and recorded. They will be required to consume varying amounts of caffeine over the test period and (85) keep a detailed journal. The study is due to start in two months, so interested parties should visit www.sleepclinic.net to complete the application form and health survey before November 15.

questions.text: What is the research focused on?

options.C: How a certain substance affects sleep

questions.explanation: Bài nói cho biết: '...the largest-ever study about the effects of caffeine on sleep.' => Nghiên cứu tập trung vào tác động của một chất cụ thể (caffeine) lên giấc ngủ (How a certain substance affects sleep). Chọn (C).

questions.text: How long will volunteers be needed?
questions.explanation: Bác sĩ Senequa cho biết: 'participants will spend seven days at the clinic having their sleep patterns monitored and recorded.' Bảy ngày ('seven days') tương đương với một tuần (For one week). Chọn (B).

questions.text: What are participants expected to do?
questions.explanation: Người nói nêu yêu cầu: 'They will be required to consume varying amounts of caffeine over the test period and keep a detailed journal.' Cụm từ 'keep a detailed journal' (viết nhật ký chi tiết) đồng nghĩa với ghi chép lại thông tin bằng văn bản (Keep a written record). Chọn (B).
